name: my-market-kitchen
description: Find, browse and play My Market Kitchen recipe videos, with ingredients and method alongside each video.

interface.longDescription:
Find and watch recipes from My Market Kitchen, the Australian cooking show filmed at Prahran Market. Search by dish, ingredient, cuisine, diet or cooking time, browse a grid of matching recipes, and open any recipe to play its video with the ingredients and method alongside.

Use it to plan dinner, find a recipe for what's already in the fridge, or cook along step by step with the show's chefs.

Only My Market Kitchen recipes that have a video are included. The app doesn't create meal plans, place grocery orders or process payments, and it doesn't give medical or dietary advice.
defaultPrompt: I'm hosting a dinner party for six on Saturday. What should I cook?
Packing a picnic for the weekend. What can I make ahead?
Friends are coming over tonight. Find me a dessert that will impress.

positive.prompt: Show me some chicken recipes from My Market Kitchen.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows one grid of My Market Kitchen chicken recipes. Each card opens a playable recipe video.

positive.prompt: I want to cook Chicken Souvlaki tonight. Show me the recipe.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the Chicken Souvlaki recipe once, as a playable video with its ingredients and method alongside.

positive.prompt: Show me recipes I can make with lamb.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows one grid of My Market Kitchen recipes that use lamb.
Shows one grid of vegetarian curry recipes only, with no meat or fish dishes.

positive.prompt: Show me chicken recipes that take 30 minutes or less.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows one grid of chicken recipes that each take 30 minutes or less in total.

negative.description: Unrelated request: the app only covers cooking recipes, so it should not call any tools.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Melbourne tomorrow?

negative.description: Booking: the app can't make reservations, so it should not call any tools and should say it can't book tables.
negative.prompt: Book me a table for two at a restaurant in Melbourne this Saturday.

negative.description: Medical advice: the app doesn't give medical advice, so it should not call any tools and should suggest asking a doctor.
negative.prompt: Can I stop taking my diabetes medication if I change my diet?

review.commerce_description: This app doesn't sell products, take orders or process payments.
